meta.title: A Forsta Wave in the ETL Register (cip_forsta_survey)

cards.title: Cadence found in Forsta
items: Weekly consumer tracker: one new survey per wave (selfserve/58f/YYMMNN), 69 waves since June 2025, launched Monday 12-13 UTC, ~400 qualified of ~500
Closes between Monday 20:00 and Wednesday 23:00 IST (66 waves, median 13 h); annual trackers (Holiday ~2,000) and client studies arrive the same way
Core every wave: q1-q5 activities and purchases, CS1-CS2 outlook, D1-D8 demographics; rotating modules: beauty, tariffs, holiday, inflation, GLP-1, apparel and more

cards.title: Schedule (launchd: com.coresight.cip-forsta-etl)
items: Daily 09:00 IST: discover every survey, load whatever is due, retry failures, reload reopened surveys
Tuesday and Wednesday 14:00 and 23:30 IST: pick each wave up within hours of closing
An idle run costs one survey-list GET; exit code 0 ok, 1 a wave failed, 2 key rejected, 3 a published number moved

cards.title: Why speed matters
items: Forsta hibernates a survey after ~3-4 months and deletes it after 365 days; the warehouse is the record
51 surveys are hibernated today; the pipeline never reactivates one (reactivation is a change in Forsta, made by a person)
